chapter_seo_title: Yinling City Arc: Li Huowang Masters the Coin Sword & Enters a Civilization Trap
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang tests his new bronze coin sword and enters the sprawling, prosperous city of Yinling, a jarring oasis of civilization in the Dao-Twisted World.
og_title: A Strange Slice of Peace: Entering the Walls of Yinling
og_description: Li Huowang’s journey hits a rare pocket of normalcy as he enters the great city of Yinling, but the silence before the storm is always the loudest.
twitter_title: Yinling City: The Last Stop Before the End?
twitter_description: New chapter! Li Huowang masters his ritual coin sword and enters the biggest city yet. The calm is deafening.

lore_anchors.definition: A traditional Daoist ritual weapon made of old coins strung on a red cord, used for exorcism and warding off evil spirits. In Li Huowang’s hands, it’s a lethal, extending weapon.
A fortified gateway enclosure, often with two gates, designed to trap and surround enemies who breach the outer gate. It functioned as a defensive kill-box in ancient Chinese city design.
